Class JetsonNTIO

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.JetsonNTIO
All Implemented Interfaces:
JetsonIO
public class JetsonNTIO extends Object implements JetsonIO
The Jetson's NetworkTables topics under /photonvision (SpectrumJetson docs/TECHNICAL.md and docs/REWIND.md). Numbers are read generically because the Jetson publishes some as double and some as integer.

      Description copied from interface: JetsonIO
